bus.name: dataengine effects stream
bus.where: JetStream stream MERGEDRILL_EFFECTS; durable consumers are named by the business (game-demo: game-level-up-mail, game-activity-phase) and by saga (roost-saga-start, roost-saga-start-result), shared by every game process
bus.after_merge: effects already published are consumed by B (or any game process) through the same durables; effects A staged but never published stay in A's outbox
bus.source: wiring/dataengine SubscribeEffects; framework/dataengine/engine/runtime.go (outbox drains at the next start)

bus.name: saga stream
bus.where: JetStream stream MERGEDRILL_SAGA (subjects mergedrill.saga.>); step consumers are shared durables (game-demo: game-gift-<step>)
bus.after_merge: a step command can carry the sender's bound sid in its payload (game-demo gift.State.FromSID) and is admitted only by that sid's process, which no longer exists
bus.action: every saga must be terminal before the merge (checked: saga:<database>)

bus.name: syncbus
bus.where: JetStream stream MERGEDRILL_SYNC; one durable per topic per sid: sync_<topic>_1001_<hash> (and <topic>.live)
bus.after_merge: A's durables keep receiving broadcast copies nobody consumes until the stream's max age drops them; B has its own durables, nothing addressed only to A is lost
bus.action: after the merge delete A's durables: nats consumer ls MERGEDRILL_SYNC | grep _1001_ ; nats consumer rm MERGEDRILL_SYNC <name>
